user.title: Klimadan heat pump
user.description: Connects to a Klimadan TFT controller through Home Assistant's MQTT broker.

data_description.unit_id: The unit's Cloud ID, the last part of its topics, e.g. 100111 in klimaDan/heartbeat/100111.
data_description.relay_id: The ID after "relay" in the board's topics, e.g. 72491 in klimaDan/relay72491/out/r1. Leave empty if you have none.

error.invalid_unit_id: The Cloud ID must be digits only.
error.invalid_relay_id: The relay board ID must be letters and digits only.
